dataset.name: Hannousse & Yahiouche (2021) Phishing URL Benchmark + UCI PhiUSIIL (2024) Root Supplement
sources: Hannousse & Yahiouche (2021), Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Vol. 104 (11,430 raw URLs, CC BY 4.0)
Prasad & Chandra (2024), UCI Machine Learning Repository ID 967 — PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset (3,000 path-matched root URLs, CC BY 4.0)

decision_thresholds.policy_description: Scores < 0.35 classify as 'legitimate'; scores in [0.35, 0.65) classify as 'suspicious' (uncertain/borderline); scores >= 0.65 classify as 'phishing'.

feature_importances.label: Suspicious Keyword Count
feature_importances.description: Count of authentication, urgency, or brand-lure keywords in the URL.

feature_importances.label: Hostname Digit Count
feature_importances.description: Count of numeric digits (0-9) inside the hostname.

feature_importances.label: Dot Count (.)
feature_importances.description: Total number of dot ('.') characters in the URL.

feature_importances.label: HTTPS Scheme Indicator
feature_importances.description: Indicates whether the URL uses the HTTPS scheme (1 = https, 0 = http). Note: HTTPS does not imply a website is safe.

feature_importances.label: @ Symbol Indicator
feature_importances.description: Indicates presence of '@' credential/redirection symbol (1 = present, 0 = absent).

feature_importances.label: Underscore Count (_)
feature_importances.description: Total number of underscore ('_') characters in the URL.

feature_importances.label: Total Digit Count
feature_importances.description: Total count of numeric digits (0-9) in the URL.

feature_importances.label: Path Slash Count (/)
feature_importances.description: Number of forward slashes ('/') in the URL path.

feature_importances.label: Total Hyphen Count (-)
feature_importances.description: Total number of hyphen ('-') characters across the URL.

feature_importances.label: Subdomain Depth
feature_importances.description: Number of subdomain levels preceding the registrable domain.

feature_importances.label: Suspicious Hostname Pattern
feature_importances.description: Composite indicator for deceptive hostname structures (embedded TLD tokens, excessive hyphens, or high-risk TLD + lure combinations).

feature_importances.label: Query String Length
feature_importances.description: Character length of the query parameter string.

feature_importances.label: Hostname Hyphen Count
feature_importances.description: Number of hyphen ('-') characters inside the hostname.

feature_importances.label: URL Path Length
feature_importances.description: Character length of the resource path component.

feature_importances.label: Digit-to-Length Ratio
feature_importances.description: Proportion of numeric characters relative to total URL length.

feature_importances.label: Hostname Length
feature_importances.description: Character length of the full hostname (including subdomains).

feature_importances.label: Registrable Domain Length
feature_importances.description: Character length of the base registrable domain.

feature_importances.label: Total URL Length
feature_importances.description: Total number of characters in the full URL string.

feature_importances.label: Query Parameter Count
feature_importances.description: Number of key-value parameters present in the URL query string.

feature_importances.label: Special Character Count
feature_importances.description: Count of special URI symbols (?, =, &, %, @, ~, +, $, !, *, ;).

feature_importances.label: URL Shannon Entropy
feature_importances.description: Information entropy (bits/char) measuring randomness across the full URL.

feature_importances.label: Hostname Shannon Entropy
feature_importances.description: Information entropy (bits/char) measuring randomness in the hostname.

feature_importances.label: IP Literal Hostname
feature_importances.description: Indicates whether the hostname is a raw IPv4/IPv6 address instead of a domain name.

feature_importances.label: Punycode (IDN) Indicator
feature_importances.description: Detects 'xn--' internationalized domain encoding often abused in homograph attacks.
